

== Japanese Premiere printing documentation ==
Confirmed Japanese Premiere printing 1301_15o, source index 4017 on p.99 of the collecting encyclopedia. The original Japanese face was visually inspected; verified field scope and source hash are retained in the batch evidence.  Missing transcription and fields still requiring source review are explicitly identified. Printing identity does not establish GEMP implementation.<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4017). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
